Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 11541 of 2021

Applicant :- Ramu
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Ors.

Counsel for Applicant :- Pawan Kumar Nigam,Anurag Dwivedi,Ram Babu Singh,Shashank Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Katyayan Mishra holding brief of Sri Anurag Dwivedi, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Jayant Singh Tomar, the learned AGA-I for the State and perused the record.
2.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 336 of 2021, under Section 376 IPC and 3/4 Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, Police Station Atrauli, District Hardoi.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 06.06.2021 at 08:47 hrs alleging that while the informant's daughter aged about 16 years had gone to ease herself in a field,
the applicant pushed her to the ground, shut her mouth and raped her.
4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that the applicant had dragged her to a eucalyptus grove and had raped her there.
5. In the medico legal examination report of the victim, no mark of injury or sign of use of force has been reported.

Although bleeding from vagina has been reported in the medico legal examination Ramu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Ors. on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34662403/
1 report, at another place it has been mentioned that the victim was menstruating.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Although vaginal swab was collected for pathological examination but no pathological report is available on record.
6. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164, she stated that she did not know the applicant's name and his name was told to her by her family members.

7. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
8. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that FIR states the place of occurrence to be a field whereas the victim stated that she was dragged from a field to eucalyptus grove; that the allegations are not supported by medico legal examination report and the pathological examination report is not available on record, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 07.06.2021 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
10. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
